source: Persona de Pierre (projet de saison, partenariat Fitness Park, recherche de partenaires). Mondiaux Hong Kong 10-13 juin 2027 (fiche client, vérifié le 06/08/2026). Budget de 30 000 € volontairement absent : à Pierre de décider s'il le rend public.

slides.texte: Hong Kong, June 2027. A season like this is not a hobby anymore. It's a project.

slides.titre: **Fitness Park** is on board this season.
slides.texte: A partner who joined the adventure for this road to the World Championships. Grateful to have them in the team.

slides.titre: Not a logo on a shirt.
slides.texte: A small number of partners, and a collaboration that makes sense for the brand as much as for me: races, training, content, communication.
Proof that you can perform at the highest level of your category without putting the rest of your life on hold.

slides.titre: If your brand sees performance this way, let's talk.

legende:
225 days to Hong Kong 🇭🇰

A season at the World Championships level is a real project: coaching, physical preparation, nutrition, physio, international travel, race entries, equipment, content. I've structured all of it.

Thank you to Fitness Park for joining this road with me 🙏

I'm building this season with a small number of partners. Not a logo on a shirt: a collaboration that makes sense for the brand and for me, across my races, my training and my content.

If your brand recognises itself in this vision of performance (father, executive, ambitious athlete), my DMs are open.
